title: ipfix: add srv6 srh information export
description:
this merge request aims to add new ipfix codepoints from the soon-to-be RFC:
https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-opsawg-ipfix-srv6-srh/

codepoints added: 492-502 from https://www.iana.org/assignments/ipfix/ipfix.xhtml
```
    { 492, "srhFlagsIPv6" },
    { 493, "srhTagIPv6" },
    { 494, "srhSegmentIPv6" },
    { 495, "srhActiveSegmentIPv6" },
    { 496, "srhSegmentIPv6BasicList" },
    { 497, "srhSegmentIPv6ListSection" },
    { 498, "srhSegmentsIPv6Left" },
    { 499, "srhIPv6Section" },
    { 500, "srhIPv6ActiveSegmentType" },
    { 501, "srhSegmentIPv6LocatorLength" },
    { 502, "srhSegmentIPv6EndpointBehavior" },
```

capture containing a few codepoints:
[srv6lab-ipfix-srv6-7101-20230618-1417.pcap](/uploads/89e7678a34c4ef77b14a2e9bbaf40fb6/srv6lab-ipfix-srv6-7101-20230618-1417.pcap)
